response.headline: Veeva Summit to Showcase AI Innovations and the Leaders Transforming R&D and Quality
response.summary: At Veeva R&D and Quality Summit on October 20-21 in Boston, Veeva Systems (NYSE: VEEV) will bring together leading biopharmas, emerging biotechs, CROs, and sites — including Duke University, Eli Lilly and Company, Pfizer, Sanofi, Tolmar, UCB, and the University of Pennsylvania — to explain how they are driving new ways of working across drug development and quality.

response.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Neutral on Pfizer, Raises Price Target to $28
response.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Carter Gould   maintains Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $27 to $28.

response.headline: Pharma Lobby Sues Trump Administration Over Medicare Drug Pricing Rule, Calls It ‘Unlawful Overreach’ — ‘The Results Are Preordained’
response.summary: PhRMA sued the Trump administration over its Medicare drug pricing rule, arguing CMS exceeded its authority under federal law.
